name: Penne Arrabbiata with Garlic-Herb Shrimp (Let the Magic Begin Menu)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Let the Magic Begin Menu
whyItWorks: White penne pasta and shrimp are 9/10 flare-safe, but "Arrabbiata" means "angry" spicy chili-tomato sauce.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the shrimp and penne pasta tossed in plain olive oil or butter with aged Parmesan instead of the spicy red Arrabbiata sauce.
watchOuts: Spicy chili-garlic Arrabbiata tomato sauce (swap for butter/olive oil)
